correctness.rationale: In the precise direction-specific NDW rule on the fixed path with endpoint opinions (0,1), center H0=1/2, ρ=1/2, ε∈(0,1/4], and uniform iid edge selection, center-to-leaf score is σH or σ(1−H), while a leaf score is σ times its center gap +(1−σ)/2. In σ<2ε both leaves remain fixed, while σ≥2ε leaves and center are frozen at initial state because of the strict confidence inequality. At σ≤ε both center updates occur for all finite times: binary-affine recursion gives dyadic uniform midpoint law, liminf=0 limsup=1 a.s. and limiting variance 1/12. For ε<σ<2ε, in overlap (1−ε/σ,ε/σ), repeated constant edge blocks force finite exit almost surely; the surviving one-way halvings give endpoint polarization with probabilities 1/2 each and variance limit 1/4. Sharp inclusion of boundaries σ=ε and σ=2ε and exact t-step variance for ε=1/5,σ=3/10 follow. Independent rational depth-eight tree checks agree for σ=0,1/5,3/10,2/5,1.
residual_risks: The almost-sure statements use the infinite-block argument, not finite branching.
The exact thresholds require the specified strict gate, homogeneous ε≤1/4, static path and one-edge asynchronous sampling.

originality.rationale: The original Krishnagopal–Porter NDW manuscript defines the mixed-direction rule and gives numerical behaviors; it does not classify the sharp three σ-regimes for this exact fixed three-agent profile. Earlier November 2 three-node theorem completely analyzes the both-directions-active oscillation wedge but not the intermediate one-way absorbing polarization or the high-σ no-update phase. Same-date pure-neighborhood star theorem explicitly assumes σ=0, so cannot entail the σ∈(ε,2ε) or σ≥2ε mixed-weight transitions. New content is the complete phase diagram and step variance, not the classical Bernoulli-affine recursion.
residual_risks: Zhang–Hong–Hu (2017) nonlocal aggregative bounded-confidence full text was not obtained; model uses distinct nonlocal interactions and any equivalence requires further checking.
No result is claimed for arbitrary graphs, rewiring or asynchronous update protocols outside the stated one-edge rule.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact minimal-network phase diagram separating sustained nonconvergence, random one-sided convergence and frozen initial consensus, with sharp equality conventions and discontinuous nonmonotone limiting variance. It is a structural boundary analysis for the original NDW mechanism rather than a generic Bernoulli-recursion exercise.
residual_risks: Novelty is restricted to the full mixed-σ trichotomy; the σ=0 affine phase and stationary uniform law are established earlier.

limitations: For ε>1/4, differing leaf receptiveness may invalidate the three-regime classification; no extension claimed.
